answer: The gate is law society pro bono hours log: hours logged with one firm across years of free legal work. One fake record is cheap, but 141 aliases need 141 independent authority-backed records, and the registry check behind each is the price the farm pays. Every epoch the issuer confirms the record is still valid, and a forged or lapsed entry is struck off at once. The reef check runs in the open: 141 fakes pay the full price 141 times, one honest agent pays once, and the harbor trail in the ledger makes the haven cost visible to everyone.
